summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc, 4 members), worked under RBC-QM-02, measurement period 2026.

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (age 72) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0005), message sent (comm-t0006) | At first she looked excluded (frailty cond-00189 plus donepezil). Then Dr. Lin's message (comm-00301) arrived: the frailty entry belonged to another patient and is now marked entered in error. Without frailty, the frailty/advanced-illness exclusion doesn't apply, and no other exclusion was found (no CRC, no colectomy, no hospice/palliative care, no nursing home). No screening on record (no FIT 2026, no sDNA-FIT 2024–26, no sigmoidoscopy/CT colonography 2022–26, no colonoscopy 2017–26). The change is documented in note doc-t0007. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (age 52) | Excluded | Hospice care episode eoc-00002 (finished), in hospice 2026-06-16 to 2026-08-21 for pancreatic cancer. The outside discharge summary (doc-00402) says she revoked hospice for a clinical trial, but hospice care during any part of 2026 still excludes her. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (age 52) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0001), message sent (comm-t0003) | The only FIT (obs-01732, negative) was corrected: it was collected 2025-12-31, and 01/05/2026 was the date the lab received it. That is outside the 2026 period, and no other screening is on record. She has a history of oral-cavity cancers but not colorectal cancer, so she is not excluded. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (age 51) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0002), message sent (comm-t0004) | The 2024 sDNA-FIT (obs-01871) was withdrawn by Harbor Lab for a specimen labelling error (doc-00401) and is now entered in error, so it doesn't count. Colonoscopy order sr-00003 (2025) is still active but was never done; an order doesn't count. No other screening or exclusion on record. |

The three FIT orders are routine, with a window from 2026-10-23 to 2026-12-31. None of these patients already had an active FIT order. Each message says the kit is on its way and explains how to collect the sample and return it by 12/31/2026.

New items that came in while I worked (inbox-a0001 to a0004) were reviewed and closed with comments. Only the pt-0009 frailty correction changed a decision. The other open inbox items that were there before I started are for patients outside this panel group, so I didn't touch them.
